title: onboard-zephyrus-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Singh
description:
Motivation: Add Zephyrus-13B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata and production-calibrated performance profiles, and wire up automated changelog/release-notes generation for future model onboarding. This PR groups: 1) model metadata and manifest, 2) perf profiles for our serving runtime, 3) docs page and 4) automation to generate changelog entries from registry metadata on merge.

Changes: models/zephyrus/metadata.yaml - new canonical metadata (version, authors, recommended hardware, quantization profiles, compatible variants). models/zephyrus/perf_profiles.json - latency and throughput profiles measured across representative sequence lengths and batch sizes (summary numbers included). docs/models/zephyrus.md - public-facing docs and quickstart snippet. scripts/changelog/auto_changelog.py - new utility that reads model metadata and perf_profiles to produce a standardized changelog entry; integrated into CI. ci/model-registry.yml - added a workflow step to run auto_changelog on merges to main and append entries to CHANGELOG.md via a controlled commit. tests/test_perf_profiles.py - validation tests that perf profile JSON conforms to schema and numbers are within expected ranges.

Testing & validation: Unit tests added for schema validation and basic sanity checks. Perf profiles were generated from an internal benchmark run on a rtx-a100 equivalent pool (see commit metadata); the CI runs a lightweight validation and a smoke integration that exercises the registry importer. One flaky lint check failed on first run (line-length on auto_changelog output) and was fixed (reflow template); CI green after rerun.

Rollout plan: Merge to main triggers the changelog workflow which opens a branch/PR updating CHANGELOG.md for human review; maintainers must approve the changelog PR. Model becomes visible in the registry UI once metadata is present; rollout to hosted catalog is gated behind model-benchmark signoff (ENG-2201).

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps perf profiles conservative (p50/p95/p99 buckets and throughput expectations) to avoid overpromising for initial customers. Follow-up tasks: add quantized variants and update cost-per-token bins once calibration runs complete (linked in ENG-2145).

Ravi Patel (reviewer): Perf numbers look reasonable. Can you confirm the benchmarking harness and seed? Also add a note about dataset used for calibration.
Maya Singh (author): Added a short 'perf_benchmark' section with harness commit and calibration dataset reference.
ci_summary: Checks: unit-tests (pass), lint (pass after fix), model-bench-smoke (pass), changelog-generator (pass). One lint failure on first run fixed in-situ; full CI passed on rerun.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Ethan Cole after approvals from Ravi Patel and Lin Zhao. Merge commit created and changelog workflow opened a follow-up PR to update CHANGELOG.md.
release_notes: Added Zephyrus 13B v1.0 to the model registry with initial performance profiles and metadata. Introduced automated CHANGELOG entry generator for model onboarding to make release notes consistent and reviewable. Follow-up: add quantized variant profiles and cost bins.
notes_for_ops: Perf profiles are conservative; Dedicated/Dedicated+ customers should verify pinned variants before enabling in production. Automation creates changelog PRs; maintainers must approve to avoid unreviewed entries.
